name: Air Fryer Crab Cake Sandwiches with Chipotle Pepper Sauce

components.name: Crab Cakes

ingredients.name: Chilled PASTEURIZED COOKED lump crab meat, drained and picked free of shells, as purchased

steps: Drain pasteurized cooked crab well, inspect for shell fragments, and keep cold. Mix crushed crackers, egg, spring onions, finely diced pepper, mayonnaise, coriander, lime and salt.
Gently fold cooked crab into binder without mashing lumps. Form four large patties or eight smaller patties; chill for at least 30 minutes so they hold together.
Lightly spray crab cakes and air fry in a single layer at about 188 C for 9-12 minutes, turning gently halfway, until the egg binder is thoroughly cooked and centre reaches 74 C.
For meal prep, keep cooked crab cakes separate from buns and vegetables. Reheat crab cakes thoroughly, then assemble freshly; avoid freezing sauce and lettuce.

components.name: Bun, Lettuce & Tomato

ingredients.name: Four wholewheat sandwich buns, about 80 g each

steps: Lightly toast buns if desired, then add one large crab cake or two small ones, lettuce, tomato and a quarter of pepper sauce per sandwich.

components.name: Chipotle Pepper Sauce
steps: Blend light mayonnaise, roasted peppers, chipotle and lime into sauce, then refrigerate.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.

Skinnytaste published crab cakes and air-fryer guidance adapted into full sandwiches with measured buns and salads. CRAB MEAT IS PURCHASED COOKED; this quantity is a pre-cooking recipe input, not raw crab purchase weight.
Planning: ADVANCE: 30-minute chilling for patty binding.
Freezer: cooked crab cakes can freeze with texture decline; buns may freeze separately; mayonnaise sauce and raw greens are NOT suitable for freezing
Dietary: Crustaceans, egg, wheat; pre-cooked crab requirement clearly stated.

Refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers at 4°C or colder, for 3–4 days at most, and follow the shorter seafood limit above. Cook fish and shellfish to 63°C and reheat leftovers to at least 74°C.

flags.shelfLife: Crab cakes — plan for days 1-3; sauce and greens don't freeze.

preservationAndReheating: Refrigerate cooked food promptly in shallow covered containers. Target within 2 hours, or 1 hour when ambient temperature exceeds 32 C.
Refrigerate at 4 C or below for 3-4 days maximum; for many fish and shrimp dishes, prioritize eating within 1-2 days for quality and freeze later-week cooked portions promptly.

Cook fish and crustaceans to 63 C (145 F) or applicable local food-safety standard, and reheat cooked leftovers to 74 C. For crab cakes containing egg binder and purchased cooked crab, reheat to 74 C.
When recipe includes rice, cool rapidly and refrigerate promptly; do not leave cooked rice at room temperature.
Freeze in suitable airtight food-safe containers. Defrost in refrigerator, not on counter. Re-crisp breading in an air fryer when possible.
Do not freeze fresh avocado, uncooked tomato/cucumber/cabbage salad, or mayonnaise/yogurt-based dressing unless kitchen-tested separately.
Freezer suitability here describes expected eating quality, not laboratory validated shelf life.
